transcript: Speaker A: ek din beizzati, do din beizzati, teen din beizzati. main aapse poochhta hoon aakhir kab tak? kab tak sirf isliye peeche hatoge kyunki tumhein English nahi aati? kab tak mahfilon mein chup rahoge ki kahin koi tumhara mazaak na uda de? kab tak apne talent ko is bhasha ki bediyon mein qaid rakhoge? duniya kehti hai bina English ke tumhari koi aukaat nahi. main kehta hoon bhasha kisi ki aukaat tay nahi karti hai par bhasha rasta zaroor rokti hai. aur ab humein rukna nahi hai. maine is darr ka ilaaj dhoondh liya hai. SpeakEasy. ismein hai Vani, aapki apni AI agent. [One day of humiliation, two days of humiliation, three days of humiliation. I ask you, until when? [This is not just an app, it's a revolution. When the whole country is changing, why are you tolerating the same old humiliation? Just 10 minutes daily, 10 minutes. Talk to Vani and bring that power to your voice that the world keeps listening. Rise and decide to change your destiny today. Click on the button below now and download SpeakEasy. Because now English won't be a fear, it will be our strength.] Speaker B: abhi SpeakEasy app download karein aur farratedar English bolna shuru karein. [Download the SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: SpeakEasy AI, Speak English Easily with SpeakEasy, Install Now, GET IT ON Google Play, Download on the App Store
summary: A motivational speaker addresses the embarrassment of not knowing English and introduces the SpeakEasy app's AI assistant, Vani, as a non-judgmental learning partner. The ad encourages users to practice for 10 minutes daily to build confidence and download the app.
